messages:
maya: heads up — new int8-rerank model onboarded to staging. seeing ~-2.3% NDCG@10 vs fp16 on our dev set. quick thread to triage.

alex: did you run the exact same doc formatting? we had past issues when concat order changed.

maya: i used the standard harness but flipped to 'concat_with_sep' during preprocessing — could that explain it? ran n=5 seeds.

li: possible. can you paste the eval command + config?

maya: ```
./eval_harness \ 
  --model rerank-int8-v2 \ 
  --datasets newsqa,webq \ 
  --query_format=paired \ 
  --doc_concat=sequential_with_sep \ 
  --metrics=ndcg@mrr \ 
  --seeds 42,7,100
```

jordan: what about query truncation? int8 may have different tokenizer rounding behavior for long queries which can shift ranks.

maya: query length distro looked identical, but i re-ran with doc_concat=original_order and ndcg recovered to ~-0.2% (within noise). so concat ordering seems like the culprit.

alex: interesting. i remember we added a micro-optimization that strips leading whitespace before concat in the quantized path. @li can you check tokenizer normalization in the quantized build?

li: on it. also want to check candidate shuffling in candidate sampling — int8 path might introduce nondet ordering after batched scoring.

maya: quick perf note: topk ordering mismatch observed in 2/1000 queries. small but concentrated on short queries where docs are similar.

eval-bot: Eval run 1768004321 completed: ndcg10_fp16=0.712, ndcg10_int8=0.695, mrr_fp16=0.321, mrr_int8=0.318, seeds=[42,7,100]

jordan: plan: (1) reproduce with fixed seed & deterministic sampler, (2) run with original doc concat and with normalized concat, (3) check tokenizer whitespace handling in quantized build. who wants to own which?

alex: I'll own (1) & (2). will run pairwise diffs and produce a tiny repro case.

li: i'll own (3) and add a unit test for tokenizer normalization in quantized binary. also will audit any pre-concat trimming logic.

maya: thanks both. can we add a unit regression for concat invariance (concat method shouldn't change ndcg on canonicalized inputs)?

li: :+1: adding test to rerank-prep. quick thought — if this is concat-order bug, a pragmatic fix is to enforce canonical doc sort by doc_id before concat.

alex: good call. also adding a dashboard regen alert for ndcg drop >1% on dev to catch this earlier.

maya: perfect. ping this thread with repro and diff so we can roll a patch if needed.
